response.rationale: The duvet cover is a non-final-sale home item delivered 35 days ago. Since days_since_delivery (35) exceeds the 30-day standard window and final_sale is False, RET-008 applies and returns are not accepted. The item is not defective (defective == False), so RET-020 does not apply. No goodwill grant or fraud hold is present, and the category is not electronics, so no higher-priority rule overrides this outcome.
